entry.author: NZ On Air
entry.summary:
Wānanga on preparing great funding applications  - hosted by Irirangi Te Motu | NZ On Air, Ngā Aho Whakaari and Te Māngai Pāho.

This webinar was for producers wanting advice on how to prepare strong, competitive funding applications.  

This kaupapa is aimed at helping producers navigate some of the more common challenges we see in applications – such as strengthening finance plans, forming more well-rounded distribution strategies, and outlining clear platform support on projects.
